## Our goal today {#l3-objective}

### Lesson objective

Interpret class intervals and use observed relative frequencies to estimate probabilities.

### Success criterion

I can place boundary values in the correct class, interpret grouped data and explain how a class probability estimate changes as results are added.

::: notes
Keep this immediately after the shared cover. Students already know frequency tables and relative frequency from Lesson 2. Today extends that knowledge to boundary conventions, grouping and experimental probability.
:::
